restart service: bash -c 'if [ "$1" = termnl ] || [ "$1" = desk ]; then sudo -n /usr/bin/systemd-run --on-active=2 /usr/bin/systemctl restart "$1" >/dev/null; else sudo -n /usr/bin/systemctl restart "$1"; fi' _ {name}
show wifi: iw dev wlan0 link; sudo -n /usr/local/sbin/symbios-wifi scan
